the best representation is the one that adapts to the task at hand.

(i) ImageNet is the best representation for a large number of visual tasks, (ii) self-supervision is not a good alternative to ImageNet, and (iii) the best representations are learned by pretraining on a combination of ImageNet and a self-supervised task.
